summaryForNext: Six seeded goals grounded against real code: G3 (ATProto outbound wiring) + G5.2 (admin-ui lint) are fully codeable wins; G4 (OIDC) is hard-blocked — no Kratos/Hydra IdP in compose and flint-gate has no authorize hook, so it becomes an ADR not code; G5.1 (Dart) stays deferred (uniffi-bindgen-dart 0.1.3 still broken); G2 (LiveKit inbound) needs the realtime SDK; G1 (str0m full SFU) is XL (~2-4wk, transport loop untestable sans browser) — recommend a thin transport-loop slice here and split full media fan-out to a dedicated phase-20.
